}}'''Bobomurat Ahmedov''' is an Uzbek physicist and academic. In November 2018, Ahmedov was elected as Fellow of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] (TWAS) in Trieste.{{Citation needed|date=April 2023}} In December 2020, Ahmedov was elected as Fellow of [[Islamic World Academy of Sciences]] (FIAS).{{Citation needed|date=April 2023}} He was honored as one of the "best scientists of the year" in the 2018 Scopus Awards.<ref>{{Cite web |last=uz |first=Kun |title=Scopus Awards 2018 forum took place in Tashkent to honor best scholars of the year (photo) |url=https://kun.uz/en/news/2018/11/23/scopus-awards-2018-forum-took-place-in-tashkent-to-honor-best-scholars-of-the-year-photo |access-date=2023-04-22 |website=Kun.uz |language=en}}</ref> He was elected a Fellow of the [[International Core Academy of Sciences and Humanities]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bobomurat Ahmedov-Core Academy |url=https://www.coreacad.org/Member.aspx?ProId=111 |access-date=2025-07-16 |website=www.coreacad.org}}</ref>

He became a member of the Academy of Sciences of Uzbekistan on December 23, 2023, according to the decree of the President of Uzbekistan Sh Mirziyoyev.
